name: Black Stone · The Maze database
source: The Maze, M. A. Bastarrachea Magnani (Axo stories). Built from web/data; do not edit by hand.

conventions.id: '<type>:<slug>' — stable, lowercase, ascii. Tables use their number: table:a, table:3-1.
conventions.page: printed page of the rulebook (same as PDF page); null = no dedicated description
conventions.refs: a row's refs point to the entity it produces (chamber, condition, creature)
conventions.appears_in: back-links: which table rows / chambers mention this entity
conventions.text: {en, es}: English is the book text; Spanish is a helper translation
